assertions.assertion: CPT code 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The patient presents with persistent palpitations and a history of symptomatic bradycardia consistent with sick sinus syndrome
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic evaluation to characterize the underlying cardiac arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The diagnosis codes I49.5, I49.9, and R00.2 support the medical necessity of this rhythm characterization
The patient has documented symptomatic bradycardia and palpitations
